sourcePolicy: Rules are derived records. They must be backed by raw weather API records or tourism research before being used as evidence.

rules.effect: Prefer indoor or short-walk alternatives when backend weather context marks outdoor suitability as limited.
rules.note: RAIN means getVilageFcst PTY 1 (비), 2 (비/눈), or 4 (소나기). The guide defines no rule for when rain makes an outdoor visit unsuitable, so outdoorSuitability must come from the backend and must not be derived here.

rules.effect: Explain shorter outdoor stays, shade, indoor breaks, or late-afternoon scheduling when heat is material.
rules.note: The forecast gives TMP and TMX, not heat risk. No source in this repository sets a TMX threshold for heat, so heatRisk must come from the backend and must not be computed from TMX here.
